versions.changelog:
No user-visible changes in this version.  
- Version update with no file or content modifications detected.

Initial release of pc368-filter-analyzer:

- Enables web scraping of PC368 lottery results, with filtering by user-specified composite (non-prime) digits.
- Excludes results with triplets or three consecutive numbers.
- Supports dynamic data loading for custom number of periods via "加载更多".
- Calculates statistics: match count, exclusion count, percentage, and profit/loss formula.
- Guides user input with strong validation and clear prompts for both composite digits and period count.
- Automatically handles pop-up closing, browser state, and error/boundary cases.
